messages.author: Timo Laine
messages.text: Moi Erkki! I just replaced the SFP on TRN-019 here at OULU-03. The link is physically up and optics look normal, but all traffic counters are staying at zero.

messages.author: Erkki Expert
messages.text: Moi Timo. Ah, that is one of those old TX-200 units from 2016. They have this weird bug sometimes with new SFPs.

messages.author: Erkki Expert
messages.text: Try to disable the interface, wait about 30 seconds, and then enable it again. Don't reboot the node, the port bounce usually does the trick.

messages.author: Timo Laine
messages.text: Okay, I will try that now. Shutting down the port.

messages.author: Timo Laine
messages.text: Tried the bounce, didn't help. Counters still stuck at zero after the disable/enable.

messages.author: Timo Laine
messages.text: Had to reboot in the end. After the reboot TRN-019 is working fine and traffic is flowing normally now.

messages.author: Erkki Expert
messages.text: Hm, so the bounce didn't work on that one, odd. Usually it is enough, but good that the reboot fixed it anyway!
